ArticleContentAreaCategoryName.description: The name of a category whose members are the valid content areas. While it is null, or the category has no members, no content area is valid, and {{#articlecontentarea:}} stores 'unknown'.

ArticleContentAreaSourceWiki.description: Wiki ID (database name) of the wiki that has the $wgArticleContentAreaCategoryName category, for a wiki farm that stores one wiki's content-area names on every wiki. null means this wiki. A source wiki whose database cannot be queried gives no valid content areas, and a warning in the ArticleContentArea log channel.
